final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT cr.raceId AS raceId, r.name AS name, AVG(cr.points) AS avgp, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId WHERE cr.points > 1.0 GROUP BY cr.raceId, r.name), s2 AS (SELECT name AS name, AVG(avgp) AS avg2 FROM s1 GROUP BY name) SELECT s1.raceId, s1.name, s1.avgp, s1.cnt, s1.avgp / s2.avg2 FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON CAST(s1.name AS TEXT) = CAST(s2.name AS TEXT) ORDER BY s1.avgp / s2.avg2 DESC LIMIT 10
